notes.title: New Content Patch! Survival Mode! Jinxes! Magic Books!
notes.content:
[i]The Witch's grimoire full of spells has been found in Hellside!
What secrets and magic might it hold..?[/i]

[b]A lot of secrets, actually![/b]
Today represents [i]The Weaponographist[/i]'s first official content patch!
We're calling it "Survivalation", but it includes even more than that!

[h1][b]Survival Mode is Here![/b][/h1]
Complete the game on Normal once to unlock the endless [i][b]Survival Mode[/b][/i].

An infinite dungeon full of increasingly harder enemies, Survival Mode is the ultimate test of your skills at combat.
Keep up your speed at all possible times!! The longer you spend underground, the more aggressive your curse will become.
With every moment that ticks by, your combo meter is getting faster and faster!

[i]Including New Leaderboards for greater challenges![/i]

[h1][b]Magical Jinxes To Change the Way You Play![/b][/h1]
Strewn throughout this new play mode are a number of the Witch's mysterious [b][i]Grimoire Pages[/i][/b].

With every Survival room completed, you'll earn more of these powerful grimoire pages, in larger and larger numbers. Venture as deep as you possibly can to complete the witch's spell book!

Pages can be used to unlock [b][i]Jinxes[/i][/b] - mysterious game modifiers that affect [i]all modes of play[/i] to completely change the way combat is done.
[list]
[*] What if... Your weapon changed out of your control..?
[*] What if... Every time you grab a same weapon, your damage starts to stack..?
[*] What if... [i]A bunch of other fun and silly things!![/i]
[/list]
[i]Some Jinxes help, and some Jinxes hurt -- But, you can mix and match them all!![/i]

[h1][b]And Thanks for Feedback![/b][/h1]
Of course, every patch in history has always included a list of ninja fixes.
Most of these, from player feedback!

Here's a small sample:[list]
[*] Lessened the "ice skating on the moon". [spoiler]Ya bullies! :)[/spoiler]
[*] Satyrs are a little less confused. [spoiler]Thanks, Jupiter![/spoiler]
[*] Smartened up a few behaviors and hitboxes.
[*] Slime Storms rebalanced to be a little bit shorter.
[*] Some enemy layouts improved a bit for fun.
[*] Prevented some cheating we saw happening.
[*] New Achievements!
[/list]
Shazam!
Danny

[img]http://www.puuba.com/media_archive/flameWizard.png[/img]

notes.title: The Demo! And Contests!! They're Here!
notes.content:
[i]Oh em geez. Oh em geez. Oh em geez!!!11one![/i]

The time has finally come, and the demo is released!
Two furious depths of demonic carnage, served fresh from the dungeon at Hellside!
Our (super meaty) demo is out today, and contains all manner of demons, powerups, and weapons to explore.
[i](My personal favorite is probably shooting a tuba at a monkey man. But, that's just me...)[/i]
[img]http://www.puuba.com/media_archive/tubaplayer.png[/img]
[h1][b]But, Also And This![/b][/h1]
Beyond that, we're running a [b]Contest All Week!![/b]
The Top Three times [b](Each Day!)[/b] in the last depth of this demo (Depth 2) can win a full-length free copy of the game when it comes out (Wednesday, the 29th!).
Just kill them demons, buy your upgrades, and smash through Depth 2 as fast as you can!

[b][i]To Enter:[/i][/b]
Just post a screengrab of your Victory Screen with your awesome time to either:
1) [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/329240/discussions/0/618459405727711073/]Here, in our Steam Forums[/url]
2) [url=https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=It's+no+big+deal,+but+I'm+probably+the+best.&hashtags=Weaponographist]Dem Twitters[/url] (Make sure to use #Weaponographist)

The top three times of each day will be picked, and get a copy on release day!

Polish your chainsaws! Sharpen your tubas!
Get in there and kill!!

[img]http://www.puuba.com/media_archive/WeaponographistContest.png[/img]
Huzzah!!
-Danny
